reviewNotes: Separate AI editorial review of 34 original B1/B2 adjective questions: every complete German sentence, all four options, single accepted answer, inflection, bilingual feedback, contextual differences and provenance reviewed. Deferred waagrecht (same objective as waagerecht), archaic weltenweit and ambiguous wohl. Corrected inherited gloss or grammatical classification for wahnsinnig, wirtschaftlich and ziemlich. Checked current GM2 production/draft objectives; no identical assessable objective identified. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval remain pending.
